answer: A farm therefore forfeits the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The vertex debit happens at intake, kernel totals the burned amount, and hollow anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 22 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
